column1: # Mesa citations below are path:line in the pinned Git commit, not patched working files.
# All grade=source; hwtest_id=- means not run on the phone. Host table tests do not promote grade.
# bpp is exact backing pipe bits/pixel; ASTC uses a rational (32/9 at 6x6).
# a840_fmt_id/swap are LINEAR sampler values; generated header retains tiled and render encodings separately.
# msaa is a mask 1|2|4 for eligible 2D optimal attachment usage, intersected with pinned global caps.
# XR stand-ins require a shader codec and are unqualified: ubwc/render/filter/blend/msaa all zero.
# Every R8G8 entry retains r8g8_faulty_fast_clear_quirk; see structured source notes below.
